text:
Spring tide
Moon phases: new and full
Solar and lunar tidal effects: reinforce each other
Tidal range: usually larger
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: NOAA National Ocean Service, Spring and Neap Tides; https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/springtide.html. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text:
Neap tide
Moon phases: first and third quarter
Solar and lunar tidal effects: partially oppose each other
Tidal range: usually smaller
provenance: Concise factual data extracted from the cited source. Source: NOAA National Ocean Service, Spring and Neap Tides; https://oceanservice.noaa.gov/facts/springtide.html. Consulted 2026-10-13.
